crumbs.label: Visit of Dr. G. N. Singh, Adviser to the Honorable Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh

title: Visit of Dr. G. N. Singh, Adviser to the Honorable Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh
bodyHtml: Dr. G. N. Singh, Adviser to the Honorable Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh visited IPC on 14th July 2021 and welcomed by Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director of IPC. Dr. G. N. Singh interacted with the officials of the IPC and enquired about the current activities and future plans of the IPC in the field of Pharmacopoeial Standardization and Pharmacovigilance. Dr. Singh desired that IPC shall enhance its reach to the stakeholders including Drug Regulatory Authorities, drug manufacturers, and general public. He also emphasised that IPC shall make efforts to collaborate with International agencies for cooperation in the areas of mutual interest. Dr. Singh wished IPC a great success in its future endeavours.
